common.按受理时价格结算。供应商返回计费 token 时按 token 结算；按时长结算: Pricing is frozen at admission. Reported billable tokens are used for token tariffs. Duration-based settlement uses reported duration when available, otherwise the ordered fixed duration. Missing billable reference video usage requires reconciliation.
common.使用平台的 /v1 地址、视频模型 ID 和 API Key。: Use the platform /v1 base URL, a video model ID, and an API key.
common.响应头 X-Request-Id 是请求编号。建议每次生成发送唯一 Idempo: The X-Request-Id response header identifies the call. Send a unique Idempotency-Key for each generation. A duplicate returns 409 and the original ID. A key for the same account can retrieve settlement status and actual token usage.
common.输入图前 {p0} 张免费，之后 ¥{p1} / 张: First {p0} input images free, then ¥{p1} / image
common.请选中文字后复制: Select the text to copy it
common.返回当前启用的平台模型、模型 ID 和配置价格。: Returns enabled platform models, their IDs, and their configured prices.
common.在 API Keys 中创建密钥，通过 Authorization 请求头发送。: Create a key in API Keys and send it in the Authorization header.
common.使用此密钥的应用将无法继续调用。: Applications using this key will lose access.
common.当前账户下还没有 API Key: You have no API keys in this account yet
common.请保存新密钥，仅显示一次: Save this key. It is shown only once.
common.我已阅读并同意: I have read and agree to the
common.无法显示二维码，请打开微信授权链接: Could not display the QR code. Open the WeChat authorization link.
common.扫码已结束，请重试: The sign-in attempt ended. Try again.
common.留空按普通输入价计费，填 0 表示缓存命中免费；按接口实际返回的命中 token: Leave blank to use the regular input price; 0 makes cache hits free. Usage comes from the provider's reported cached tokens.
common.基准价由后台提供，DeepSeek 固定使用高峰价；填入基准价不改变收费倍率。: Base prices come from the server. DeepSeek uses peak prices. Applying base prices keeps your billing multiplier.
common.收费倍率（1=原价，0.9=9折，大于 1=加价倍数）: Billing multiplier (1 = base price, 0.9 = 10% off, above 1 = markup)
common.填写 ComfyUI 分组 Token；模型名称填写工作流 ID。支持参考图和音: Use a ComfyUI group token and enter the workflow ID as the model name. Supports reference images and audio, but not reference videos or keyframes.
common.统一管理文本、图片、视频与画质增强模型。: Manage text, image, video, and video enhancement models.
common.画质增强能力尚未加载: Enhancement capabilities have not loaded yet
common.单条视频或成片提升清晰度，按后台配置选择输出档位。: Increase clip or episode resolution using configured output tiers.
common.搜索模型名称或模型 ID: Search model name or model ID
common.管理账户的 API 密钥，用于调用平台模型: Manage account API keys for platform model access
common.创建你的第一个 API Key，连接平台模型，开始调用 AI 能力。: Create your first API Key to connect with platform models and AI capabilities.
common.支持图片 · 视频 · 文本模型: Supports image, video, and text models
common.选择该密钥可以调用的模型: Select models this key can invoke
common.支持 Seedance 等视频生成模型: Supports Seedance and other video models
common.支持 Seedream、GPT-image 等图片生成模型: Supports Seedream, GPT-image and other image models
common.支持豆包 Seed-Evolving 等文本模型: Supports Doubao Seed-Evolving and other text models
common.出于安全考虑，该密钥仅在此展示一次，关闭后将无法找回。请立即复制并妥善保管。: For security, this key is only displayed once and cannot be recovered after closing. Please copy and store it securely immediately.
common.浏览与调用平台模型，支持图片、视频、文本等多模态能力: Browse and invoke platform models across image, video, and text modalities
common.请尝试调整搜索关键词或重置筛选条件: Try adjusting search keywords or clearing filters
common.使用标准 JSON 参数，结果统一返回 data[].url。图片由客户端直接从: Use standard JSON parameters and receive data[].url. Clients download results directly and upload references to temporary OSS.
common.固定为 url，避免 Base64 大文件经过服务器。: Always url, so large Base64 files do not pass through the server.
common.已直传 OSS 的参考图片 HTTPS 地址。: HTTPS reference image URLs uploaded directly to OSS.
common.只提交文件类型、字节数和 MD5 摘要，获取临时 OSS 上传地址。客户端用票据: Submit only the MIME type, byte length and MD5 digest to obtain an OSS upload ticket. PUT the file directly using the ticket headers, then send read_url for generation. Upload URLs last 10 minutes; temporary media is cleaned up after two days.
common.图片、视频或音频的 MIME 类型。: The image, video or audio MIME type.
common.文件的实际字节数。: The actual file size in bytes.
common.MD5 摘要的 Base64 编码，不是文件内容。: Base64-encoded MD5 digest, not the file contents.
common.生成接口只接受不超过 1 MB 的 JSON 和媒体 URL，不接收 multi: Generation endpoints accept only JSON up to 1 MB and media URLs. Multipart files, data URLs and Base64 media are rejected. See the AI integration guide for a complete upload example.
common.临时 OSS 的参考图链接，SDK 中放在 extra_body。: A temporary OSS reference image URL; use extra_body in the SDK.
common.支持普通响应和流式输出，可使用模型已启用的工具调用与结构化输出。: Supports standard and streaming responses, along with enabled tool calls and structured output.
common.模型目录中的文本模型 ID。: A text model ID from the catalog.
common.设为 true 时逐段返回，默认 false。: Set true to stream responses. Defaults to false.
common.include_usage=true 返回本次调用的 token 用量。: Set include_usage=true to receive token usage for this call.
common.模型目录中的图像模型 ID。: An image model ID from the catalog.
common.所选模型支持的清晰度或像素尺寸。: A quality tier or pixel size supported by the model.
common.模型目录中的视频模型 ID。: A video model ID from the catalog.
common.描述画面、动作和运镜。: Describe the scene, actions and camera movement.
common.参考素材，每项包含 type、role 和 url。: Reference media, each with type, role and url.
common.用于断线后找回任务的唯一请求标识。: A unique request ID for retrieving the task after a disconnect.
common.响应头 X-Request-Id 返回的请求编号。: The request ID returned in the X-Request-Id header.
common.使用 OpenAI SDK，修改 Base URL 和 API Key。已启用的: Use the OpenAI SDK with this Base URL and API key. Keep an enabled original model ID or copy an ID from the catalog. Streaming, tools and structured output are supported.
common.使用官方 seconds、size 和 input_reference 参数提交: Submit standard seconds, size and input_reference parameters to receive a Video object. Poll its ID and download the completed video through the content endpoint.
common.生成秒数，例如 4、8、12，以所选模型支持为准。: Duration as a string, such as 4, 8 or 12, depending on the model.
common.status 为 completed 时，使用 client.videos.do: When status is completed, use client.videos.download_content(id). Existing duration, resolution, aspect_ratio and references extensions remain available.
common.上游错误保留原始 HTTP 状态码、响应体、Content-Type、Retry: Upstream errors retain their HTTP status, body, Content-Type, Retry-After and X-Request-Id. The platform records the request ID and status. Echoed credentials are redacted.
common.平台产生的认证、权限、参数和并发错误使用标准 error 对象。流式响应开始后的: Platform authentication, permission, validation and concurrency errors use a standard error object. Errors after streaming starts are returned through SSE.

ConfigPage.负责剧本理解、人物提取、分镜文本生成与来源视频拆解。: Understand scripts, extract characters, generate storyboards and analyze source videos.
ConfigPage.负责角色定妆、场景概念图和一致性参考图生成。: Generate character designs, location concepts and consistency references.
ConfigPage.负责分镜片段生成、动态镜头和最终视频合成。: Generate shot clips, moving scenes and final video compositions.
ConfigPage.请将 YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID 替换为百炼业务空间 ID；提交到 vi: Replace YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID with your DashScope workspace ID. Submit to video-synthesis and poll /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}.
ConfigPage.提交到 /contents/generations/tasks，并通过任务 ID: Submit to /contents/generations/tasks and poll asynchronously using the task ID.
ConfigPage.删除后该模型将无法继续用于新的生成任务。: This model will no longer be available for new generation tasks.
ConfigPage.官方配置由平台维护，团队管理员只读: Platform-managed configuration; read-only for team administrators
ConfigPage.可同时选择多个用途；勾选“重制”表示该模型支持视频输入并可用于来源视频拆解。: Select multiple uses. “Remake” requires video input support for source video analysis.
ConfigPage.请配置全部清晰度档位的输出图单价: Set an output image price for every resolution tier.
ConfigPage.支持 Seedream 与 GPT Image 系列；清晰度、比例与格式由所选类: Supports Seedream and GPT Image models. Quality, aspect ratios and formats come from backend capabilities.
ConfigPage.支持 Seedance 系列与 MiniMax H3；分辨率、比例、时长和请求格: Supports Seedance and MiniMax H3. Resolution, aspect ratio, duration and request format come from backend capabilities and adapters.
ConfigPage.协议决定请求字段与尺寸适配，不依赖模型名称猜测供应商。: The protocol determines request fields and sizes; the provider is not inferred from the model name.
ConfigPage.留空表示不预检: Leave empty to skip preflight checks
ConfigPage.深度思考/推理模型可关闭思考以提速并避免正文被 reasoning 挤占。: Disable thinking for reasoning models to improve speed and preserve output space for content.
ConfigPage.限制单次请求输出，避免 JSON 因达到 token 上限被截断。: Limit output per request; ensure enough space to avoid truncated JSON.
ConfigPage.开启后发送 response_format=json_object；关闭后仅使用: When enabled, sends response_format=json_object. Otherwise, JSON is requested through prompts only.
ConfigPage.支持多轮工具调用（创作助手必需）: Supports multi-turn tool calling (required for the assistant)
ConfigPage.输入参考视频（元 / 秒，按输入时长）: Reference video input (CNY / second of input)
ConfigPage.输入音频免费，不计入费用。: Audio input is free and not included in costs.
ConfigPage.负责视频原声转写、智能字幕与时间轴对齐（火山引擎 SeedASR 2.0 等）。: Transcribes video audio, generates smart subtitles and aligns the timeline (including Volcengine SeedASR 2.0).
